creative_objective: Speak to the woman who already trains legs and glutes but sees no change: show her daily drop ritual as an honest 3-month routine (what many women notice, never result deadlines), prove the desire with an illustrated before/after inset of hips in jeans, and anchor the real bottle.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) headline, 2) segment seal, 3) before/after inset and the bottle, 4) timeline points, 5) bottom bar with 'Pagas al recibir'
art_direction.composition_style: Headline across the top, pill under it, square seal top-right; left column timeline, right column inset card plus bottle; full-width bar at the bottom
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Generous cream margins, timeline evenly spaced, the bottle overlapping the lower edge of the inset card
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat illustration with soft paper texture; only the bottle is photographic with a soft contact shadow
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: The reference image is on a warm cream background: a two-line headline in very bold dark-green uppercase across the top; under it a long dark rounded pill with the program and segment in white; on the right a square dark seal with a double border and the segment in white. Left 50 %: a vertical timeline with a dark line and 6 round dots, each with 'DÍA N' in bold and two lines of text, and a botanical illustration to the left of each point. Right: one big amber dropper bottle standing. Bottom 12 %: a full-width yellow bar with the offer in black uppercase. No person. Our version keeps the same order, uses 4 timeline points, recolors to cocoa and lemon, and because every image in this app must show the problem and the result with a person, adds an illustrated before/after inset card behind the upper part of the bottle on the right. The yellow bar carries the trust items instead of an offer.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 flat-illustration image ad on a warm cream background (#FFF6DC) with a very subtle paper texture. TOP 20 %: a two-line headline left-aligned in Poppins ExtraBold uppercase, deep cocoa #2B1A10, very large, the second line ending with the words in lemon yellow #F5E13A outlined in cocoa; directly under it a long rounded deep-cocoa pill (about 62 % of the width) with white Poppins Bold uppercase text. TOP-RIGHT CORNER: a square seal about 20 % of the width, deep-cocoa fill with a double white border and three lines of white Poppins ExtraBold uppercase text. CENTER 66 %, LEFT 48 %: a vertical timeline, a thin cocoa line with 4 round cocoa dots evenly spaced; next to each dot a label in Poppins ExtraBold uppercase cocoa ('DÍA 1', 'SEMANA 2', 'MES 1', 'MES 3') and below it two lines in Poppins Regular dark cocoa; to the left of each dot a small flat watercolor-style botanical illustration: ashwagandha sprig with smooth oval leaves and small orange berries, a beige maca root, a fenugreek sprig with smooth oval leaves in groups of three, and a deep-purple beet root with smooth leaves; no serrated leaves. CENTER, RIGHT 50 %: an upright rounded cream card with a thin gold (#C9962B) border, occupying the upper part of the right column (about 34 % of the canvas height), split by a thin vertical cocoa line into two flat illustrations with clean dark outlines of the SAME adult Colombian woman in her mid-20s (dark wavy ponytail, warm tan skin, light-grey gym top), seen in three-quarter side view, framed from the waist to mid-thigh at hip height, inside a small gym corner with a pink dumbbell on the floor: LEFT HALF before, she wears light-blue jeans one size too big, her hips are straight and narrow, the denim hangs loose at the back with a baggy fold under the seat, her hand pulls the back waistband about a fist away from her lower back showing the empty gap, frustrated face looking down; RIGHT HALF after, another day, dark-blue jeans that fit snug, hips clearly wider than her small waist, rounder lifted glutes and fuller thighs filling the jeans, smiling over her shoulder. A small curved yellow arrow points from left to right. In front of the lower edge of that card, standing upright and overlapping it, the real product bottle at about 42 % of the canvas height, label facing front and fully legible, with a soft realistic contact shadow; the bottle is photographic, everything else is flat illustration. PRODUCT: use the attached product photo as the only source of truth: ONE amber-brown glass dropper bottle about 2.6 times taller than wide, Boston-round body with rounded shoulders, ribbed matte black collar about 55 % of the body width, tall matte black rubber dropper bulb, wrap-around label lemon-yellow fading to white with 'amua', the big white outlined word 'VITALDROPS', 'All-In-One Multi-Herbal Supplement', five outlined ingredient circles and 'Dietary Supplement 2 fl. oz. (60mL)'. Not slim, not squat, never mirrored, matte, no rainbow, no lens flare, no yellow '60ml' circle. BOTTOM 12 %: a full-width lemon-yellow (#F5E13A) bar; on its left a rounded badge with a 2 px deep-cocoa border, white fill, a small hand-and-box icon and cocoa Poppins ExtraBold text; to its right, the rest of the bar text in Poppins ExtraBold uppercase deep cocoa.
